answer.rationale: The low-cost vendor is the only option clearly meeting the mandated 18% component-spend reduction, while the incumbent has refused repricing. Verify the archived evidence that its onboarding was quick and invoicing accurate, then transition through a guarded, staged allocation rather than an immediate broad switch. Because the line is already at 94% of committed volume with no buffer, delivery and downstream continuity risk remains material and should be explicitly monitored.
